meta.title: Capacity options
meta.basis: Costs are James' figures for equipment the farm has either built before or been quoted for.

financing.note: FSA announces its rates monthly, so this figure carries the month it was read.

alternatives.label: Bank or credit union, well qualified

options.label: Salatin tractor

capital.label: Materials
capital.note: Materials cover lumber and its delivery, corrugated aluminum, chicken wire, and hardware.

capital.label: Reservoir bucket
capital.note: The reservoir bucket is food grade.

options.label: Model 600
options.summary: The Model 600 is a manufactured coop that carries its own feed and water.
options.halvedNote: The quote covers a pair, and both the price and the assembly hours are carried here at half so a single coop can be costed on its own. Delivery sits inside the quoted price and may not halve as cleanly as the rest.

blank: The labor rate is unset. Build hours are counted but never priced, because no rate has been agreed for the owners' own time.
The second coop has never had to win the argument against the capacity the 2027 plan asks for.
Eligibility is unresolved. FSA products are not interchangeable, and which one a mobile coop qualifies for is a question for the county office rather than a figure to assume.
